steps.name: android-h264-encoder
steps.subject: Record video with this project's H.264 encoder (motoh264enc) when it is available
steps.description:
Snapshot recognises the GStreamer element of the Android hardware codec bridge as an H.264 encoder,
hardware accelerated, and sets its bitrate, ahead of openh264enc and x264enc.

dep3.X-Rungic-Status: Inappropriate [the encoder is this project's Android codec bridge]
dep3.X-Rungic-Tests: none (gap: no scenario records video in Snapshot)

steps.name: android-camera-clock
steps.subject: Android camera source: no pipeline clock of its own, timestamps on arrival
steps.description:
The Android camera source (device.api moto-android) timestamps frames with CLOCK_MONOTONIC. With it
providing the pipeline clock, camerabin lost sync when it added or removed the audio recorder; the
source now provides no clock and timestamps buffers on arrival.

dep3.X-Rungic-Status: Inappropriate [the camera source is this project's Android camera bridge]
dep3.X-Rungic-Tests: none (gap: no scenario records video in Snapshot)
